I just went and saw Kingsman: The Secret Service, and it was glorious. I'm sure many movie lovers have similar complaints a I have had for quite a while regarding Hollywood's eagerness to milk classic franchises for a quick money grab, resulting in movies that don't feel like they belong to their universe. I'm thinking of Kingdom of the Crystal Skull, the new Star Trek movies, the Platinum Dunes stuff even the Hobbit trilogy, the list goes on forever... This has been going on for a while now, one can argue the Star Wars prequels already fall into this category, and it has often made me think whether the existing history of movies is becoming a hinder to the making of new ones, because it becomes harder to think of original ideas.

However, last year Guardians of the Galaxy came out. Guardians is very obviously inspired by Star Wars (I don't know the comic source material, but I suspect that, too, owes something to Star Wars), and I think the new Star Wars movies are going to have a very hard time to deliver the same quality. But Guardians was inspired by it, and very aware of its ancestry, unlike for example the new Star Trek movies, which had stories that were struggling to fit into the Star Trek universe and would probably have been better if they weren't forced to. The same is obviously true for Kingsman. It owes a lot to classic James Bond movies, and it is in many ways a truer sequel to Moonraker and Goldfinger than the new James Bond films are. Like Guardians, it is very aware of the clichés and tropes of old spy movies, and successfully integrates or lampshades then.

I hope this will be a new trend of unapologetically fun movies that build on the legacy of older franchises without trying to force a completely different story into a beloved franchise.
Kingsman and Guardians of the Galaxy, a new hope for Hollywood
Galaxy benefited by also being apart of the Marvel juggernaut franchise, but I agree it was something still fresh which made it stand out.
I hope we're going to see a return of the 80s style of really fun fantasy/scifi movies.
